visual_verdict.reasoning: Identity subroutes now resolve by direct SSR IDs, and sessions/roles/org gained FD-001/Oyatie Cloud proof cards, status feedback, and local routes into policy/evidence/cloud/product surfaces.

browser_console.text: Oyatie prototype dashboard mounted the visual fallback because the selective WASM island package is not present in /pkg.

known_limits: This slice upgrades Identity subroute anchors and sessions/roles/org command surfaces only; it does not assert the full dashboard mockup is complete.
Interactions are intentionally local visual state and route activation; no SSO, IAM, HRIS, payroll, receipt vault, or cloud provider wiring was added.
Console info about missing /pkg is expected in fallback SSR smoke because the selective WASM island package is not served by the local container.
